reply:
CORS enforcement is browser-side. The server responds normally; the browser reads the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header and blocks JavaScript from accessing the response if the origin doesn't match. curl ignores that header entirely, so it sees the response.

The server isn't rejecting the request—it's the browser blocking access to the response. The fix is server-side (send the right Access-Control-Allow-Origin header), but the blocking happens in the browser.
